Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one high-fidelity raster design proposal for the Goal Hint predictions HOME PAGE, as a wide landscape presentation board approximately 2400x1450. Input image 1 is the CURRENT desktop homepage structural reference; input image 2 is the CURRENT mobile homepage structural reference. They are references, not content to paste unchanged. Show desktop on the LEFT taking 73% of width, and the mobile screen on the RIGHT taking 24% of width, aligned at the top with comfortable narrow gutter. Flat front-facing UI, clean screenshot-style rendering, no physical monitor or phone frame, no photography, no perspective. One design direction per image. Both screens must use the SAME design and sample content.
Top outside the UI: small restrained label "DESIGN {NUMBER} · {TITLE}", with "Goal Hint · Home page proposal · Illustrative data" underneath. A pale neutral surrounding board and a very small bottom note "Design proposal only". Keep enough resolution for crisp readable typography.

PRESERVE the current information architecture and compact density. Desktop: navy brand bar with the existing teal football Goal Hint logo and white wordmark; Predictions active followed by Live, Results, Slip builder, Help, More and theme icon. Heading "Today's Matches", right-aligned Today / Next 3 days / Next 7 days / Next 30 days. Search "Team or league" and square teal Search button. One compact full-width filter section with date and time controls on first row, Leagues: Any / Countries: Any / Markets: Any / Odds: Any / Probability: Any on second row. The date preset is Today, and From time / To time show Any. One small helper below the fields says "Highest probability pick across any market". Then a small default summary at left ("Today · Any time · Any league · Any country · Any market") and Sort by / Earliest first / Clear filters / Apply filters on right. Desktop action text MUST read "Clear filters" and "Apply filters" on ONE LINE. "Predicted Matches", "Showing 1–8 of 228 matches". Dense full-width table with navy heading row: # / Date & Time / League / Home team / Score / Away team / Market / Prediction / Probability / Result / detail chevron. Eight compact rows. Very narrow pagination at bottom.
Mobile: copy the current compact structure: navy Goal Hint brand bar with theme icon, search with square Search action, horizontal day strip showing Tue-Oct 13, Wed-Oct 14 SELECTED, Thu-Oct 15 with arrows and Calendar square, then a compact action row with Earliest first / Clear filters / Apply filters / Filters. Mobile action labels MUST use TWO LINES: "Clear" above "filters" and "Apply" above "filters"; square buttons of identical height. Use a slim Filters icon button to keep the toolbar compact, "Showing (228 matches)" small right-aligned. Seven compact SQUARE ticket rows visible. Each row has a slim league-and-kickoff metadata strip, HOME and AWAY on TWO stacked lines with small crests/flags, plus a slim RIGHT pick stub with dashed vertical divider; stub shows its selected market abbreviation (1X2 / GOALS / DC / BTTS), bold pick and probability or "No pick / Not predicted". Fixed navy bottom nav Matches / Live / Results / More, Matches active teal.

SAME ILLUSTRATIVE SAMPLE DATA for all proposals, date Wed, Oct 14:
1. Friendlies Women, 00:00 EAT, Venezuela W / Colombia W, Match result, 2, 62%, Pending
2. Serie B, 01:30 EAT, Athletic Club / Londrina, Total goals, Over 2.5, 68%, Pending
3. Gaúcho - 3, 01:30 EAT, São Paulo RS / Futebol Com Vida, No market, No pick, —, —
4. Liga de Expansión MX, 02:00 EAT, Tapatío / Tepatitlán, Double chance, 1X, 76%, Pending
5. Friendlies Women, 02:00 EAT, USA W / Spain W, Both teams to score, Yes, 71%, Pending
6. Friendlies Women, 02:30 EAT, Brazil W / Argentina W, Match result, 1, 70%, Pending
7. Primera A, 02:30 EAT, Bucaramanga / Águilas Doradas, Total goals, Under 3.5, 74%, Pending
8. CONCACAF Caribbean, 03:00 EAT, Portmore United / Violette AC, Match result, 2, 59%, Pending.
Score column shows vs, current unavailable state is demonstrated by row 3. Predictive values are fictional illustrative layout data.

Base brand: Manrope-like clean sans typography, navy #102A3A, teal #007F7A, page #CEDBE3, white surfaces, text #102A3A, muted #486071, subtle borders #C5D4DE. Market semantic accents: Match result emerald #00824A with pale #DBF9E7, Total goals blue #2563EB with pale #E3EDFF, Double chance violet #7C3AED with pale #EFE9FF, Both teams to score orange #C2410C with pale #FFEADB. All controls, tabs, cards, badges and frame corners SQUARE: zero radius. Quiet fine rules, strong alignment, careful spacing, compact but legible. No hero, no sidebar, no stats/KPI tiles, no ads, no large empty margin, no new features, no consent pop-up, no Next.js developer overlays, no exaggerated shadows, no decorative textures. Do not reproduce the old GoalPredict brand.
MANDATORY FILTER BEHAVIOR represented visually: Date defaults Today; Time, Leagues, Countries, Markets, Probability, Odds default Any. Each fixture shows the available pick with the HIGHEST PROBABILITY across all markets, with its corresponding available odds; do not choose the largest odds instead of the highest probability. Clear filters resets every filter to these defaults. Show no selected Match result in the Markets FIELD because default is Any. Action buttons exactly Clear filters / Apply filters: 1 line desktop, 2 lines mobile. All these requirements take precedence over any old filter labels visible in reference screenshots.

directions.title: Refined Original
directions.direction: Closest to the current application: keep its pale blue-gray page, navy header and white surfaces. Improve typographic alignment, reduce noisy border contrast, use 1px rules and slight teal highlights. Retain desktop original two-row filters and mobile two-line team tickets. Elegant precise polish with minimal structural change.

directions.title: Crisp White
directions.direction: Use a near-white #F8FAFC page with crisp white table and filters, navy brand and table bars unchanged. Restrained light gray alternating rows, subtle cool borders and emerald pick badges. Mobile has white tickets on near-white background and a darker top bar. The distinctive change is a bright elegant white workspace.

directions.title: Teal Precision
directions.direction: Keep the original pale blue-gray page. Use slender precise teal 1px top rules on filters and table, thin teal outline for selected date cell and teal action area. Navy table heading is solid flat. Right mobile prediction stub uses an extremely pale teal tint, bold emerald pick, tiny straight probability meter. Analytical polished compact layout.

directions.title: Editorial Navy
directions.direction: Preserve structure. Give the page disciplined editorial typography: medium compact title, strongest dark navy team labels, quiet gray meta text and generous clear baselines within dense rows. Use white surfaces and pale blue-gray page. Slightly taller slim navy table heading with small uppercase labels. Mobile card meta strip in pale slate, bold dark navy stacked teams, outlined white prediction stub. No serif or magazine hero.

directions.title: Soft Slate
directions.direction: Use muted cool slate #E7EDF1 page and white surfaces, #CBD5DC fine borders, softened light gray card metadata strips. Deep navy brand bar. Reduce visual saturation in controls and rows, keeping teal primary actions and emerald pick semantic accents. Slightly smaller square badges and quieter alternating table rows. Mobile slate background separates white ticket cards.

directions.title: Compact Ledger
directions.direction: The most compact professional variation: desktop rows slightly shorter around 36px, tabular numerical columns, dates on one line where possible, thin horizontal grid rules, small 1X2 and pick cells, solid navy header. Use original palette. On mobile tickets around 74px high, two aligned team lines and precise fixed-width prediction stub, 5px gaps. Keep text readable and no missing filters. Strong ledger-like alignment.

directions.title: Quiet Prediction
directions.direction: Preserve original layout and density. Prediction emphasis uses white square chips with a slim emerald LEFT rule and bold navy pick digits; slim emerald straight probability bar paired with readable percent. Reduce colored fills, pastel emerald Market labels remain. Mobile prediction stub white with a subtle emerald 2px top rule, clear 1X2 / pick / probability vertical hierarchy. Clean restrained color with prominent prediction values.

directions.title: Framed Workspace
directions.direction: Keep existing sequence but visually unite desktop search, full filter controls, summaries, count and table within ONE square white workspace panel on pale blue-gray page. Fine horizontal dividers separate sections, no rounded nesting. Brand bar and page heading remain outside. Mobile has one unified white feed surface with thin dividers between compact ticket rows, maintaining two stacked team names and slim dashed prediction stub. Distinct by unified grouping, not new architecture.

directions.title: Delicate Teal Wash
directions.direction: An elegant very pale teal page #EDF6F4 and almost-white filter surface, white table rows, deep navy branding. Selected day cell uses a subtle pale teal fill with square thin teal outline. Fine desaturated teal separators. Mobile right stubs use barely visible mint tints; emerald picks and teal actions. Keep all treatments very light and avoid gradients.

directions.title: Evening Charcoal
directions.direction: Use existing dark theme as the only dark variation: page #141C22, surfaces #1E2932, brand/table bar #101820, primary text #F1F5F7, muted #A3B4BF, borders #35434C, teal accents #53D5C6. Flat charcoal, subtle alternating row fills, no glow. Predictions use muted emerald square badges and pale mint readable text. Mobile same compact ticket format, darker slim meta strips and dark prediction stub. Elegant calm dark palette, full desktop controls preserved.

directions.title: Navy Ticket Headers
directions.direction: Give mobile tickets compact DARK NAVY metadata strips with white league name, muted pale date and teal small kickoff time, above white stacked team bodies. Keep the right pick stub white with bold dark navy digits and emerald percentages. On desktop use slim dark navy filter section captions and a solid navy table heading, white rows with soft stripes. Distinctive contrast at slim metadata bars; square cards, no new groups or features.

directions.title: Minimal Dividers
directions.direction: A continuous clean white mobile feed: remove outer boxes and gaps around ticket rows, use only thin horizontal slate separators across the existing league metadata strip, stacked team area and slim right prediction stub. A subtle dashed vertical stub boundary stays. Whole mobile content white, dark navy bar. Desktop white page, borderless white filter grouping and fine horizontal-only table rules. Zero rounded edges or shadows. Distinctive open minimal line-separated list, compact density.

directions.title: Compact Prediction Rail
directions.direction: Retain compact stacked-team tickets but use a narrow fixed-width right prediction rail with a larger bold emerald pick numeral, small 1X2 above and small percentage below. Rail pale blue-gray; tiny teal top rule. Wider team area and slightly narrower stub, no probability meters. On desktop Prediction and Probability are tightly aligned compact bold numeric columns, Pick digits in plain emerald text; all other structure unchanged. Original navy/teal brand, cool white page.

directions.title: Fine Grid
directions.direction: Distinctive professional data grid treatment: faint 1px vertical and horizontal borders between every desktop table cell, light slate header labels within navy heading bar, white surfaces. Filter controls share an aligned fine square grid. On mobile square ticket rows have exceptionally precise fine slate rules between metadata, team area and prediction stub; metadata strip pale blue with small tabular kickoff. Team names medium weight, pick digits navy on white. Compact technical elegance, no oversized text.

directions.title: Teal Brand Bar
directions.direction: A restrained brand-color variation: solid DARK TEAL #006E6A top brand/navigation bars on desktop and mobile instead of navy. White Goal Hint wordmark and inverse pale teal football mark; table heading remains deep navy. White page and cards, light mint selected date and fine teal outlines. Mobile metadata pale neutral slate and prediction stub almost white mint. Preserve density and all original locations. No gradient, no glow, square action controls.

directions.title: Understated Blocks
directions.direction: Use a very pale gray page with white blocks and hardly visible outer borders. Distinctive square DARK NAVY prediction blocks within existing mobile right stubs, showing small white 1X2, a bold white pick numeral and pale mint percentage. No-pick stub remains pale gray for clarity. Desktop numeric prediction badges likewise small square navy tiles with white 1 or 2, probability plain dark navy. Keep all content and hierarchy; flat uniform fine borders, no shadows.

directions.title: Midnight Blue
directions.direction: A distinctly NAVY dark-theme variation, different from charcoal: page #0F2230, white-blue text, surfaces #163243, metadata strips #102A3A, lines #2A4A5A and subtle aqua accent #6EDDD0. Cards medium navy and stubs darker navy; prediction digits light mint. Desktop navy-blue surface/table rows and pale aqua focus strokes, all filter labels clearly readable. No black charcoal, no neon or gradient. Compact square grid and tickets preserved.

directions.title: Warm Ivory
directions.direction: A restrained warm-neutral light option: off-white ivory #F5F4F0 page, white cards, very soft warm-gray rules and metadata fills. Keep ORIGINAL dark navy brand bar and teal actions. Slightly darker ink navy teams, unobtrusive gray meta text, emerald pick accents. Table has ivory alternating rows and navy heading. Mobile white ticket bodies and pale ivory prediction stub. Clean contemporary typography, no paper texture, no retro illustration. Same compact layout.

directions.title: Navy Outlines
directions.direction: Use fine deliberate NAVY outlines on white mobile ticket cards and key rectangular controls, original pale blue-gray page. All corners dead square. Metadata strips white with a thin teal underline; stubs white and the bold emerald pick is outlined by a small square navy keyline. Desktop filter panel and table have fine navy outer keylines but pale inner rules, solid navy table header and white rows. Refined crisp strong geometry without thick borders or boxing every word.

directions.title: Emerald Pick Panels
directions.direction: Distinctive richer but restrained prediction emphasis: existing mobile right stubs are solid MUTED EMERALD #16654F with white small 1X2 and bold white pick plus pale mint percent, leaving team bodies white and slim metadata cool gray. No-pick stub pale slate with dark navy text. Desktop small square prediction cells solid muted emerald with white digits and percent stays plain navy. Keep original navy header, teal actions, cool light page and compact controls. No oversaturated green or extra features.
